feeds.title: Global Munchkins
feeds.description: Global Munchkins is a luxury family travel + lifestyle website. We are passionate about inspiring families to get out & travel as much and as far as they can WITH their kids in tow. We showcase the very BEST family-friendly travel destinations, resorts, cruises, and experiences along with tips & tricks for finding the best rates and ensuring every trip you take is a great one.

feeds.title: Ciao Bambino!
feeds.description: We help families travel the world. Our luxury family travel planning services empower families to enjoy meaningful experiences and collect lasting memories. Ciao Bambino is an award-winning online Family Travel guide paired with a Virtuoso family vacation planning service.

feeds.title: Wandermust Family
feeds.description: We are Fearless Family Travellers who believe that your travel adventures don't have to stop just because you have a family. We love reviewing luxury travel accommodation and experiences, writing destination guides and offering top tips and travel inspiration for other families. On a mission to prove that travel with a baby is not only possible but fun!

feeds.title: La Jolla Mom Blog
feeds.description: I'm Katie. I write La Jolla Mom. La Jolla Mom shares the best tips for San Diego vacation planning, luxury hotel perks, travel worldwide, theme park ticket discounts, & much more. I recap our trips and favorite places around the globe. I also talk about our favorite airlines, airport lounges, and gear. My information will help you plan and spend less on traveling.

feeds.title: Luxe Travel Family
feeds.description: Luxe Travel Family is a luxury family travel blog sharing the best family travel destinations, luxury experiences, and travel trips from around the world. I am Nancy, a media member of the North American Travel Journalists Association (NATJA), Travel Media Association of Canada (TMAC), and Family Travel Association (FTA).

feeds.title: The Daily Impressions
feeds.description: I started this blog to not only share pieces of my family's journey through life but to also be a resource to Army wives, moms and parents who love to be active with small children. Get information on accessible luxury travel experiences both Domestically and Internationally with small children.

feeds.title: Luxe Recess
feeds.description: A luxury family travel magazine for parents who like really nice hotels and other luxuries while traveling with the kids. Our community will help you plan a fabulous trip, and we can also upgrade your family with many hotel perks on your next vacation. Luxe Recess LLC is a luxury family travel magazine that features the world's best hotels and their family experience.

feeds.title: World Travel Adventurers Blog
feeds.description: World Travel Adventurers travel blog offers the best tips for affordable luxury travel, couples travel, & family travel. We show you how to travel like a millionaire without spending a fortune and will inspire you to travel more and travel better! Plan your dream vacation today with our travel tips for deluxe holidays.

feeds.title: Family Twist
feeds.description: Explore our travel tips, travelers' experience and stories, travel guides and more! Family Twist offers exclusive activities & breaks for families traveling to Europe with kids. We provide luxury family-friendly transportation, baby sitters, restaurant recommendations and more to ensure the comfort and safety of your family.

feeds.title: Well Traveled Kids
feeds.description: Well Traveled Kids is a luxury travel agency & travel blog dedicated to the art of traveling well with kids. We book luxe vacations and hotel stays for our clients with incredible VIP perks! Our site features reviews of luxury family resorts and expert family travel ideas to inspire our readers to work with us to plan their next great luxury family vacation!

feeds.title: Luxurious Family Vacations Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog for travel guides, tips for easy and stressfree family vacations, luxury travel and more! I am a professional Travel Advisor helping busy families plan luxury vacations to Disney and other family friendly destinations around the world, where parents and kids can feel like royalty.

feeds.title: Whitney World Travel Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest travel news and advice about Family and Luxury Vacations, Cruise and Disney Destinations from Whitney World Travel. Whitney World Travel was founded with a simple concept in mind - help families, couples, and friends plan stress free family and luxury vacations.

feeds.title: Travel Happy Blog
feeds.description: Hawaii travel agency specializing in modern luxury and family travel. I'm Marissa. I'm a toddler mom, wife, and roommate to two sweet rescue cats. My husband and I have always loved to travel, and now our daughter does too. I also plan luxury vacations, resort stays, and tours - and I blog about it all.
